# tunnel

```go
import "banyan/tunnel"
```

Package tunnel provides TCP tunneling over libp2p streams, enabling peers to forward TCP connections through the libp2p network. This allows accessing services on a remote peer's local network as if they were directly accessible.

The package implements a simple request\-response protocol:

1. The initiator opens a libp2p stream and sends a TunnelRequest specifying the target host and port
2. The responder connects to the local TCP target and sends a TunnelResponse
3. If successful, the stream becomes a bidirectional pipe between initiator and target

Security is enforced through target whitelisting \- by default only localhost targets are allowed, but this can be configured via SetAllowedTargets.

<a name="Handler"></a>
## type [Handler](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/tunnel/tunnel.go#L47-L53>)

Handler manages TCP tunnel streams, handling both incoming tunnel requests and outgoing tunnel establishment. It enforces target access controls and provides bidirectional data relay between libp2p streams and TCP connections.

```go
type Handler struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="NewHandler"></a>
### func [NewHandler](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/tunnel/tunnel.go#L58>)

```go
func NewHandler(h host.Host, ctx context.Context, logf func(format string, v ...interface{})) *Handler
```

NewHandler creates a new tunnel handler and registers the stream handler with the provided libp2p host. The logf function is used for logging; if nil, a no\-op logger is used.

<a name="Handler.OpenTunnel"></a>
### func \(\*Handler\) [OpenTunnel](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/tunnel/tunnel.go#L213>)

```go
func (h *Handler) OpenTunnel(peerID peer.ID, targetHost string, targetPort uint16) (network.Stream, error)
```

OpenTunnel establishes a tunnel to the specified target via a remote peer. The returned stream can be used for bidirectional communication with the target. Returns an error if the peer rejects the tunnel request or connection fails.

<a name="Handler.SetAllowedTargets"></a>
### func \(\*Handler\) [SetAllowedTargets](<https://github.com/cyberscoundrel/banyan/blob/main/apps/node/tunnel/tunnel.go#L74>)

```go
func (h *Handler) SetAllowedTargets(targets []string)
```

SetAllowedTargets configures the list of allowed target hosts for incoming tunnel requests. Use "\*" to allow all targets. If the list is empty, only localhost targets \(localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1\) are permitted.
